line.name: Flor de Nicaragua Ventus Aurum
line.filler: Nicaraguan (Habano seed, grown in Estelí and Jalapa)
line.background_text: Ventus Aurum is a tier within Joya de Nicaragua's Flor de Nicaragua brand, one of JDN's oldest lines, historically sold mainly in northern Europe/Spain rather than the U.S. market. It uses tobaccos grown in the selected valleys of Estelí and Jalapa in northern Nicaragua. It does not appear to have been reviewed or distributed by major U.S. outlets and could not be confirmed on JDN's official U.S. site.

research_notes: Could NOT verify 'Canon' or 'Corona' vitolas (photographed in our library) for this line from any source - only Robusto and Magnum 52 were confirmed to exist. No critic reviews found for this line - appears to be a Spain/Europe-market-only product not covered by major English-language cigar press. Exact length for Magnum vitola, release year, and any scored reviews are unverified - left null/empty. RECOMMEND: double-check the 'Canon' and 'Corona' vitola photos against Magnum 52/Robusto in case of a naming mismatch.
